    {"source_unit_id": "P1", "text": "The cold-storage logistics center operations system consists of a warehouse management system (WMS), 3 refrigeration units, 40 temperature sensors, a door controller, and an emergency generator. The temperature sensors measure the freezer room temperature every 5 min."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P2", "text": "Externally, there are the refrigeration unit manufacturer's service center and the shipper; facility operation is handled by the facility manager, and inventory management by the logistics manager."},

    {"source_unit_id": "P6", "text": "While access is restricted, the logistics manager moves the cargo scheduled for shipment to the backup freezer room and notifies the shipper of the shipment delay. The two tasks proceed simultaneously."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P7", "text": "When the freezer room temperature rises above -15 °C, the logistics manager delivers the cargo temperature records to the shipper. On this day, the temperature did not rise to -15 °C, so the records were not delivered."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P8", "text": "At 5:00 a.m., the service center replaces the compressor cooling fan and restarts Refrigeration Unit 2."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P9", "text": "When Refrigeration Unit 2 is restarted, the facility manager returns the output of Refrigeration Units 1 and 3 to normal."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P10", "text": "At 6:00 a.m., when the freezer room temperature recovers to -20 °C, the WMS lifts the freezer room access restriction."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P11", "text": "The logistics manager returns the cargo in the backup freezer room to its original locations one after another and resumes shipment."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P12", "text": "The facility manager compiles the failure circumstances and reports them to the shipper."},
